analysis.overall: You had a strong day overall with 84% time in range and smooth overnight stability, though an early morning dip and a late-morning post-breakfast rise required extra attention.

events.title: Afternoon dip and bounce
events.description: Glucose drifted down to 60 mg/dL around lunch, prompting 20g of carbs which nudged you up to a brief peak of 182 mg/dL before settling back down.

events.title: Well-handled dinner
events.description: Your 50g carb dinner was covered smoothly, keeping glucose well within range and barely exceeding 149 mg/dL.

events.title: Early morning low
events.description: Following an infusion site change around 6:45 AM, glucose dropped to a daily low of 58 mg/dL before rising back into target range.

events.title: Late-morning breakfast spike
events.description: Glucose began climbing a couple of hours after your 8:25 AM breakfast (60g carbs), reaching a peak of 235 mg/dL before corrections started bringing it down.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch for a delayed rise after higher-carb breakfasts like today's to see if timing or pre-bolusing needs a slight adjustment.
